svg.text: 1 One fitting, three placements. Rail A, vertical leg:
heel on 51.5 cm, legs → wall end
heel on 52.0 cm, legs → far end
heel flush with the corner end, legs → far end
2 Bolted: each slot sits over the hole it made (rail A from the knee space, rail B cut)
rail B's end on A, outer face on the 52.0 cm mark
